title: Uniform Asymptotic Theory for Local Likelihood Estimation of Covariate-Dependent Copula Parameters
summary: Conditional copula models allow dependence structures to vary with observed covariates while preserving a separation between marginal behavior and association. We study the uniform asymptotic behavior of kernel-weighted local likelihood estimators for smoothly varying copula parameters in multivariate conditional copula models. Using a local polynomial approximation of a suitably transformed calibration function, we establish uniform convergence rates over compact covariate sets for the local log-likelihood, its score, and its Hessian.
